quests.name: A Parcel for the Realtor
quests.summary: Carry a parcel across Kelanreach to the realtor.
intro: This should have gone to the realtor days ago and I cannot leave my post.
Take it over for me and come back when it is done.
outro: Delivered and settled? Good. Here is something for the legwork.

lines: player: A delivery from the banker.
At last. I had begun to think it lost. Tell them the account is settled.

quests.name: Word to the Barber
quests.summary: Call on the barber of Kelanreach and bring back their answer.
intro: I need an answer from the barber and I would rather not shout it across the street.
Call on them as a customer, then ask how our accounts stand.
outro: Balanced? Then I can sleep tonight. My thanks.

lines: player: The general store keeper sent me to ask after the ledgers.
Tell them the figures balance, for once. There is nothing owed between us this season.

quests.name: Eyes on the Kelanreach Sewers
quests.summary: Climb down into Kelanreach Sewers and report what you see.
intro: Something has been scratching under the streets at night. It comes from Kelanreach Sewers.
Go down the entrance, take a look around and come back in one piece.
outro: So it is as bad as I feared. Thank you for looking, that took nerve.

quests.name: Trouble with Spiders
quests.summary: The sword shop keeper wants the spider near Kelanreach thinned out.
intro: The spider beyond the walls grow bolder every week. Customers will not walk the road.
Put down 13 of them close to Kelanreach and I will make it worth your while.
outro: The road is quieter already. Here, as promised.

quests.name: Short on Maple Logs
quests.summary: The archery shop keeper of Kelanreach has run out of maple logs.
intro: My stores are bare. I need 26 maple logs and nobody in Kelanreach has any to spare.
Bring them to me, however you come by them.
outro: That will keep me going for a good while. Take this for your trouble.

outro: Balanced? Then I can sleep tonight. My thanks.

quests.name: The Long Hunt
quests.summary: Hunt the creatures around Kelanreach and bring back raw lobster.
intro: The wilds around Kelanreach need a firm hand. Start with 13 giant spider outside the walls, then 21 giant rat down in Kelanreach Sewers.
When that is done, bring me 21 raw lobster to show for it.
outro: A proper hunt. The town will eat and sleep easier for it.

quests.name: Votes for the Council
quests.summary: Gather support around Kelanreach for the general store keeper.
intro: The council meets soon and I am short of friends.
Speak to the realtor, carry whatever they give you, and see that the paperwork is lodged.
outro: Agreed, all of them? You have a talent for this. Here.

lines: player: The general store keeper asks whether you will stand with them at the next council.
I will, if the food shop keeper does. Take this sealed note over and we shall see.
player: A sealed note, from the realtor.
Hm. They want my vote. Very well, tell your employer it is agreed.

quests.name: Sweeping the Kelanreach Sewers
quests.summary: Clear giant spider out of Kelanreach Sewers and tell the general store keeper.
intro: Kelanreach Sewers is crawling with giant spider, and they come up through the drains.
Go down, kill 21 of them, then let the general store keeper know their cellar is safe.
outro: Both done? Kelanreach owes you more than I can pay, but take this.

lines: player: Kelanreach Sewers is clearer than it was. 21 giant spider fewer.
Then the cellars on this street are safe a while longer. I will tell the others.

quests.name: Supply Run to Narustead
quests.summary: Gather coal for the sword shop keeper, then carry a shipment to Narustead.
intro: I have an order from Narustead and nothing to fill it with.
Bring me 26 coal, then take the packed shipment to the banker there and do some business while you are in town.
outro: They took the lot? Then we have a trade route. Your share, as agreed.

lines: player: Goods from the sword shop keeper in Kelanreach.
From Kelanreach? Then the roads are open after all. Set it down there.

quests.summary: Gather raw tuna for the food shop keeper, then carry a shipment to Narustead.
intro: I have an order from Narustead and nothing to fill it with.
Bring me 21 raw tuna, then take the packed shipment to the banker there and do some business while you are in town.
outro: They took the lot? Then we have a trade route. Your share, as agreed.

lines: player: Goods from the food shop keeper in Kelanreach.

quests.name: The Thing Beneath Kelanreach
quests.summary: Find what rules Kelanreach Sewers, weaken its nest and destroy The Ooze Mother.
intro: Something rules Kelanreach Sewers and it is getting stronger. I want it gone.
Ask the realtor what they have heard, see it for yourself, then come back and we will decide how to break the nest.
When it is weak, kill it and tell the banker.
outro: I felt the ground go still. Kelanreach is yours to walk freely, friend.
Take this. It is everything I promised and a little more.

lines: player: Have you heard anything from below the streets?
Every night. Something large is down there, and the small ones answer to it. They call it The Ooze Mother.
So you have seen it. We can thin them by force, or I can have the guard hold the drains if they are supplied.
steps.prompt: How will you weaken the nest?

options.text: I will cut them down myself.
Supply the guard and let them hold the drains.

lines: player: The Ooze Mother is dead. Kelanreach Sewers is quiet.
Then the vaults are safe and so is everyone above them. The town will hear of this.

quests.name: The Fall of the Fallen Warden
quests.summary: March on Ashen Redoubt, break its creatures and bring down The Fallen Warden.
intro: Ashen Redoubt has stood against Kelanreach for too long. The Fallen Warden sits at the bottom of it.
Learn what you can from the clothes shop keeper, fight your way through 31 zombie and end The Fallen Warden.
Bring 16 bones back so the town can rebuild.
outro: It is done, then. They will sing about this in every tavern from here to the coast.
Take your reward. You have more than earned it.

lines: player: What do you know of Ashen Redoubt?
Only that those who go in come back thin and quiet. The Fallen Warden rules it now.
player: Word from Kelanreach: The Fallen Warden is dead.
Dead? Then the caravans can leave at dawn. This news is worth more than gold.

quests.name: The Kelanreach Trade Route
quests.summary: Open a trade route between Kelanreach and Narustead.
intro: I mean to open a trade route to Narustead. It needs a contract carried, a road made safe and a courier who is proven underground.
Deliver the contract, trade there, cut down 31 bat near our walls and prove yourself in the dungeoneering caves.
Then have the armour shop keeper underwrite the venture.
outro: Signed, safe and funded. You have changed the fortunes of this town.
Here is your cut of the first season.

lines: player: A contract from the banker in Kelanreach.
A fair offer. But the road between us is not safe, and you know it.
player: The route to Narustead is open and the contract is signed.
Then I will underwrite it. Kelanreach has not had news this good in years.
